description: This file defines a PHP class SugarWidgetSubPanelDelegatesSelectButton that extends another class and provides a method to generate HTML and JS code for a select button in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM subpanel.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelDelegatesSelectButton
classes.description: A class that generates a custom select button for delegate selection in a subpanel, extending SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates HTML and JavaScript code for a button that, when clicked, invokes a JavaScript function to select target delegates.
